alignments.note: ἵνα → that, the word introducing the English clause (rule 40).
Genitive pronoun carrying the English possessive.
Rule 20: αὐτῶν is present and free and takes their, so the article realizes nothing.
καρδίαι → hearts.
Aorist passive subjunctive; modal and copular auxiliaries ride with the lexical verb under rule 9.
Participle expanded to they being knit together; the supplied subject pronoun and copula are rule 7 helpers on the participle, and together realizes the συν- preverb under rule 106.
ἐν → in.
ἀγάπῃ → love.
Coordinating καί.
εἰς → unto.
πᾶν → all.
πλοῦτος → riches; the ASV gives it no determiner of its own.
Rule 21: the article takes the English determiner and the case preposition of rides with it, headed on the.
Rule 66: one Greek noun rendered by adjective-plus-noun where the noun glosses the lexeme, so full assurance heads on assurance.
Rule 23: the ASV gives understanding no determiner, so nothing anchors this article and the case preposition stays with the noun.
Determinerless genitive: of stays with the noun under rule 21.
The ASV expands εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν into a finite clause; under rules 40 and 61 the preposition is realized by the word introducing that English clause, here the bare complementizer that.

The noun ἐπίγνωσιν is verbalized as they may know; the supplied subject and modal are rule 7 helpers on it. Reading that as part of this unit and leaving εἰς unrepresented remains defensible, but rule 61 places the clause-introducer on the preposition.
Article → the.
μυστηρίου → mystery.
Rule 23: article before a name with no English determiner; the case preposition stays with the noun.
Determinerless genitive: of God is one unit on the noun under rule 21.

Rule 105: the supplied appositional even is decided by the class of the token carrying the appositive. Here that token is a bare anarthrous noun, neither a preposition nor a substantival article, so rule 32's 'and nothing else' does not bite and the even folds in as a rule 7 helper. Marking even added under rule 5 remains defensible.

review_notes: The ASV's textual note ('The ancient authorities vary much in the text of this passage') is recorded; the projection's readings are all translated and no token is orphaned, so rule 97 is not in play. v004 is selected on r00-base and covers s022 θεοῦ, which the English realizes.
s017/s018 split under rule 61's principle: the preposition governing a nominalized construction takes the English clause-introducer and the nominal takes the verb.
